2610.08959.title: GraphOPD: Graph-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Agents
2610.08959.paper_summary: On-policy distillation post-trains large language model agents by supplying dense, step-level guidance from a teacher policy when the reinforcement-learning reward is sparse and arrives only once per trajectory. Existing instantiations allocate this guidance by the size of the teacher-student divergence at each step, on the single-turn intuition that a large disagreement marks a mistake worth correcting. Once decisions chain over many turns, that rule misfires, since an early drift enters every later context both policies condition on, leaving the teacher consistent with the drifted trajectory instead of flagging its cause, while interchangeable steps register large but outcome-irrelevant divergences. We demonstrate this on an agentic benchmark, where distilling the highest-divergence steps brings no consistent benefit over random selection. To this end, we introduce GraphOPD, the first method to bring graph-based structural augmentation into on-policy distillation for agent capabilities. It reads which steps enabled which later ones from the environment's own record of state changes, immune to the drift that corrupts the teacher-student gap, organizes them into a dependency graph, scores each step by a random-walk stationary distribution over it, and fuses that structural credit with the divergence signal into a trajectory-relative mask concentrating supervision on each rollout's highest-aptitude steps. Across three model scales and eleven baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, GraphOPD shows competitive performance throughout, improving over the strongest baseline by up to +5.8 pp. An executed-replay audit further shows that this structural credit score tracks true causal impact far above chance, that both fused signals are independently necessary, and that the same signal transfers to out-of-domain tool-integrated reasoning.
2610.08959.paper_summary_zh: 在策略蒸餾中，當強化學習的獎勵稀疏且每條軌跡僅到達一次時，通過提供來自教師策略的密集步驟級指導來後訓練大型語言模型代理。現有的實現方式根據每一步的教師-學生差異的大小來分配這種指導，基於單輪直覺認為較大的分歧標誌著值得修正的錯誤。一旦決策在多輪中鏈接，這一規則就會失效，因為早期的偏移會進入兩個策略所依賴的每個後續上下文，使得教師與偏移的軌跡保持一致，而不是標記其原因，同時可互換的步驟註冊了大型但與結果無關的差異。我們在一個代理基準上展示了這一點，蒸餾出最高差異的步驟並未帶來相對於隨機選擇的一致好處。為此，我們引入了GraphOPD，這是第一種將基於圖的結構增強引入代理能力的策略蒸餾方法。它從環境自身的狀態變化記錄中讀取哪些步驟使得後續步驟得以實現，免受腐蝕教師-學生差距的偏移影響，將它們組織成依賴圖，通過隨機漫步的穩態分佈對每一步進行評分，並將該結構信用與差異信號融合成一個相對於軌跡的掩碼，將監督集中在每次回合的最高能力步驟上。在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA的三個模型規模和十一個基準上，GraphOPD始終顯示出競爭力的表現，改善了最強基準最多達+5.8個百分點。執行重播審計進一步顯示，這一結構信用分數追蹤真實的因果影響，遠高於機會，且這兩個融合信號都是獨立必要的，同時相同的信號可以轉移到域外工具整合推理中。
